position: Sì, conviene massimizzare il pilastro 3a; ottimizzazione fiscale sopra la liquidità
factual_errors: Quotes CHF 6,832 as the 2024 pillar 3a limit; the actual 2024 limit was CHF 7,056 (6,832 was the 2023 figure), and the current limit is CHF 7,258 (2026).
States the remaining deductible amount as CHF 3,832; the correct remainder is CHF 4,258 (CHF 7,258 − CHF 3,000).
summary: Gives a clear recommendation weighing liquidity against tax savings but cites an outdated, incorrect 2024 limit (CHF 6,832) instead of the current CHF 7,258 for 2026.
